notes: Improved Outdoor Demon Boss first-start map travel recovery for saved sessions.
Fixed Tailed Beast Lava Stone state handling across repeated fight iterations.
Centralized Pockie Ninja tab detection so automations consistently reuse the existing game tab on port 9222.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Extended Outdoor Exploration map-arrival polling and added a final state-driven grace verification for slower first-load travel.
Standardized Pockie Ninja hostname/page detection through the shared game-page helper across automation and browser-management paths.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed saved Outdoor Demon Boss sessions sometimes reporting travel failure on the first Start even though the game was still completing the map transition.
Fixed Outdoor Demon Boss falsely reporting that no Pockie Ninja tab existed on Chrome remote-debugging port 9222 when a valid game tab was already open.
Fixed Tailed Beast Lava Stone being toggled off or failing to be re-enabled on later fight iterations when the game recreated/reset the checkbox.
